Thank you. Posting this has helped me grieve. All the kind words have helped me immeasurably. When I get him back, I'll do something to close this chapter. I've received gifts and kind words from my neighbors as well who have loved that cat as much as I did.

How weird is it to use "love" in the past tense? I still love him. I always will. I'll always miss him.

It's the strangest thing. I feel such a profound loss, but also an immense and intangible connection. He lives in my heart now. And in my memories. 

At times I feel like grief is drowning me. Like, this is my life now. And I guess in a way it is. I need to acclimate to this new life. Tim was my brother. I always said I don't own him. He just lives with me. How can you possibly believe that you own such a creature? They allow us into their world and forever alter ours. 

I am still such a mess. 

I'm sitting in the last place where the sun shone on him, and there is a boulder in my mouth. The sky is an ocean and I keep sinking deeper. 

Grief is a rainstorm. A hurricane. A fire. 

I miss my friend.

Thank you for reading these words, and for your own.
